subject: general
question: Which place in India has been chosen as a UNESCO world heritage site in 2018?

options.text: Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai

solution:
The correct answer is __**Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai** were inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2018.
 
• This site includes a collection of 19th-century Victorian Neo-Gothic public buildings and 20th-century Art Deco buildings in the Fort area of Mumbai.
 
• The Victorian Gothic buildings include the **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (formerly Victoria Terminus)** and the **University of Mumbai**.
 
• The Art Deco buildings include the **Eros Cinema** and the **Marine Drive** area.
 
• This ensemble represents the transformation of Mumbai from a fortified city of the 19th century to a modern commercial city.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **UNESCO World Heritage Sites** are landmarks or areas with legal protection by an international convention administered by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO).
 
• The aim is to preserve these sites for their cultural, historical, scientific, or other forms of significance.
 
• India has a rich cultural heritage with 40 UNESCO World Heritage Sites as of 2023, including the Taj Mahal, Qutub Minar, and the Red Fort Complex.
 
• The inclusion of sites in the UNESCO list helps in their preservation and also boosts tourism and international recognition.
